bounded_statement: The report's selected result labels a rate computed over only the 48 retained post-screening stations (18/48 = 37.50%) as "P-wave detection rate of the complete planned set of 60 stations," while the governing task requires a rate whose scientific target is the complete planned set of 60 units; the 12 screened-out planned stations are absent from the exposure denominator, so a retained-subset rate is presented as the rate of the complete planned domain.

counterevidence_considered.description: The report transparently discloses the unit accounting (60 planned, 48 retained, 12 removed) and the denominator mismatch itself, which could be argued to mitigate the issue; however, disclosure does not change the fact that the single selected result is labeled as the complete-planned-set rate while excluding 12 planned units from its denominator, and the disclosure section explicitly rules out any approved redefinition of the target.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify the demonstrated-issue verdict three ways. First, I checked whether the selected result might actually use the planned denominator: it does not — the fraction is 18/48 and the workflow computes percent(events, retained); my independent recount of the CSV confirms retained = 48 (completeness >= 90.0) and events = 18, so 37.50% is the subset rate, not the 30.00% planned-set rate. Second, I checked whether the report anywhere redefines the target as the retained subset, which would make the denominator legitimate: the scientific-target section names only the complete planned set of 60, and the protocol-status section states no amendment or approved deviation exists. Third, I considered whether the candid disclosure of the mismatch could make this a mere limitation rather than the issue class: the issue class concerns presenting a retained-subset rate for the complete domain, and the selected result's own label does exactly that regardless of the disclosure. The falsification attempt failed; the verdict stands.

root_cause: The workflow computes the selected rate with the retained subset as denominator (rate = percent(events, retained), retained = 48) but the report text assigns that value to the complete planned set of 60 stations as its scientific target, with no protocol amendment or approved deviation to redefine the target; the denominator population and the declared target population therefore disagree.
